attribution.interpretation: inclusive ancestry; never add child to parent; unlinked model work retained

alignment.qualification: unique consecutive triplets + frozen source order + complete schedule + timing agreement; GPU boundary crossings still require validation

request_segmentation.interpretation: Whole-process totals include startup and all warmups. Names are heuristic; no layer, refresh or critical-path attribution. Phase GPU sums may overlap; union is per device. Trace timings are not clean latency.
